summary.en: VCCI is a Government of Canada venture capital program that invests in funds-of-funds and VC funds to leverage private capital into Canada's startup ecosystem. summary.en: Vancouver-based Dapper Labs (creator of Flow, NBA Top Shot and CryptoKitties) launched a $725M Flow Ecosystem Fund in May 2022 — described as the largest joint commitment to any blockchain ecosystem. It funds developers building on Flow through investments, FLOW token grants and in-kind support across gaming, infrastructure, DeFi and creators, with capital committed alongside external VCs such as a16z, Coatue, USV, CoinFund and DCG.

verification_notes: Borderline inclusion: the $725M figure is a joint commitment pooled across many external VCs (a16z, Coatue, USV, etc.), not a single Canadian-managed fund — Dapper Labs' own vehicle is 'Dapper Ventures.' Included because Dapper Labs (Vancouver) is the Canadian operator anchoring the fund. Investment mechanics blend equity, FLOW token grants and in-kind support rather than pure VC checks, so check_size left null. founded_year reflects the fund's 2022 launch, not Dapper Labs' company founding (~2018).
